processingNote: Asset Recovery Wave 3 (2026-08-18): transform-matrix rescale derivative, produced jointly with deer-optimized.glb (docs/assets/reviews/biology-life-visual.md flags this pair as needing a JOINT scale pass, not independent normalization, to preserve realistic relative proportions). Applied a uniform scale of 0.149421 to the root node only (geometry/mesh data untouched) via a small @gltf-transform/core script, bringing bounding-box height from ~2.677m to exactly 0.4m (within the review's cited real-world fox shoulder-height range of ~35-40cm). Combined with the deer's 0.350958 scale factor (source ~4.274m -> 1.5m, within its ~1.2-2m real-world range), the deer:fox height ratio becomes 3.75:1, inside the review's target 3-4:1 real-world range (source ratio was ~1.6:1). No geometry, material, texture, or license/attribution facts changed. Original file preserved unmodified alongside this derivative.

validation.notes: Scale applied at the root-node transform (matrix/TRS), not baked into vertex data. Jointly derived with deer-optimized.glb to preserve real-world relative proportions -- do not re-normalize either file independently.
